billed_as: IMTIAZ VIRTUAL - explore all our locations and projects virtually in 3D with walkthrough option. A new way to showcase Imtiaz Developments to your clients.
status: PARTIALLY CHECKED - stopped on instruction, not finished
verdict: Mixed. The map layer is demo content; the individual project experiences behind it are real. Do not quote anything off the map.

evidence: A badge reading DEMO sits beside the project count.
34 projects across 6 cities including Riyadh, Jeddah and Doha. Imtiaz builds in the UAE.

Eight project names repeat across markers with different prices and unit counts, alternating 16 and 32 units: Ewan Residence, Roya Gardens, Sedra Vista, Manara Tower, Yasmin Park, Areen Court, Nawar Heights, Saffron Bay.
None of those eight appear in Imtiaz's real portfolio on record: Cove, Pearl House, Westwood, Raw District, Symphony, Seacliff, Wynwood, Sunset Bay, The Archive, Hyde Walk, ENRE.

real_layer.what: The per-project experiences the map opens into
evidence: Sea Cliff at Dubai Islands opens as a real Imtiaz project: 152 units, 1BHK / 2BHK / 3BHK / 4BHK Duplex, sizes to 5,069 sqft, with a floor-level colour overlay on the building.
Sea Cliff matches 'Seacliff by Imtiaz', which we already hold 20 units of from the 28 Aug sheet.
Its payment plan reads as genuine terms: 50% pre-handover and 50% on completion. 20% booking, then seven instalments of 5% from Q3 2026 to Q4 2027, 50% on completion Q1 2028.
Each project carries Overlays, Gallery (28 exterior renders for Sea Cliff), Progress, Payment Plan, Brochure and Call Back.

so_what: The tool is real and the project data inside it is worth having. What is fabricated is the portfolio-level map someone forwarded as a client-facing showcase. A broker working off the map would quote projects that do not exist; a broker opening a single project appears to get genuine terms.
not_established: Whether every project behind the map is real, or only some. Only Sea Cliff was opened.
Whether the map markers link to the real project they name, or to whatever project the vendor wired behind a demo pin.
Whether the payment plan shown is current.
How the underlying project data could be read in bulk rather than by clicking.
next: Ask Imtiaz directly whether there is a production build and whether broker access to the underlying data is on offer. Do not scrape the demo.
notes: The root URL has no route; anyone tapping the link as sent gets a black screen. Working entries are /interactive-map, /tour, /floorplate, /abu-dhabi, /yas-island, /zoomable-map.
The page opens a websocket to backoffice.server.virtualvisions.studio and registers a visitor profile, so every broker who opens it is tracked by the vendor.
At desktop width the project view refuses to render and asks you to rotate to portrait. It is built for a phone.
